newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen shares end lower on clampdown worries.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen shares end lower on clampdown worries.

text.p: Shenzhen's A and B share indices closed lower on Thursday as worries that Beijing would enact new anti-speculation policies sparked selling and nudged investors to the sidelines, brokers said.
Turnover in the A and B markets shrank, with investors largely adopting a wait-and-see stance, they said.
The foreign currency B share index slid 2.04 points or 1.28 percent to end at 156.77 on turnover of HK$48 million against Wednesday's HK$75 million.
